<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">

  <text x="36" y="470" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#050505">+1 (415) 555-0198</text>

  <text x="24" y="506" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#050505">Biography</text>
  <rect x="24" y="513" width="342" height="51" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#4E4B66" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="36" y="536" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#050505">Independent journalist covering cities, culture,</text>
  <text x="36" y="554" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#4E4B66">and the people shaping tomorrow.</text>

  <text x="24" y="584" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#050505">Website</text>

  <text x="36" y="618" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#1877F2">mayathompson.com</text>

  <rect x="326" y="680" width="40" height="24" rx="12" fill="#1877F2"/>
  <circle cx="354" cy="692" r="9" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
